X 为原始分，M_age 与 SD_age 取自内置的四层年龄常模（18–29: X is the raw score; M_age and SD_age come from the built-in four-band age norms (18–29 / 30–49 / 50–69 / 70+). dir is the direction coefficient: indicators where 'lower is better' (reaction time, interference, trail time) take −1, while span, count and accuracy where 'higher is better' take +1. The standard score SS uses the classic Wechsler scale (mean 100, SD 15); 85–115 is the average normative range. The percentile PR is derived from the standard normal CDF Φ, computing the error function via the Abramowitz–Stegun rational approximation (precision ≈ 1.5×10⁻⁷). A dimension score is the arithmetic mean of its subtests' standard scores; the composite is the mean of all subtests. Reaction-time indicators are first trimmed: when trials ≥ 5, the slowest trial is dropped before averaging to reduce single lapse bias.

Device differences directly affect reaction-time indicators: touchscreens and Bluetooth keyboards are typically 20–60 ms slower than wired keyboards, so cross-device comparison is of limited value; use the same device for longitudinal tracking.

human-benchmark.8 项经典认知子测验，逐项换算常模百分位，汇总为记忆·注意·加工速度·执行四维能: 8 classic cognitive sub-tests, each converted to normative percentiles and aggregated into a four-ability radar (Memory · Attention · Processing Speed · Executive) plus a 0–100 composite Brain Index. Runs entirely in your browser — no connection, no data uploaded.
human-benchmark.每项子测验得到原始分后，按人群正态常模（均值 μ、标准差 σ）换算百分位：分数越: Each sub-test converts its raw score to a percentile via a population normal model (mean μ, SD σ): for lower-is-better tasks percentile = 1 − Φ((x−μ)/σ); for higher-is-better, percentile = Φ((x−μ)/σ), where Φ is the standard normal CDF. Each ability score is a weighted pool of sub-test percentiles (Memory 30% / Attention 25% / Processing Speed 25% / Executive 20%), and the composite Brain Index is their weighted mean (0–100) — equivalent to "you beat x% of people". Norms are empirical values from public literature for self-reference only, not medical or clinical diagnosis. Random delays and targets use crypto.getRandomValues; feedback tones use AudioContext.

time-perception.测你的「时间感」与「节奏感」：一秒挑战、双击速度、节拍同步三大模块，误差分布用: Test your sense of time and rhythm: one-second challenge, double-click speed and beat synchronization, with error distributions drawn as canvas charts, plus local bests and history curves. All computed locally in your browser — no network, no upload.
time-perception.一秒挑战用 performance.now() 精确记录按压时长， signed: The one-second challenge records press duration precisely with performance.now(); signed error = estimated duration − 1000 ms (positive = too long). Mean absolute error (MAE) and SD σ describe stability, and percentiles come from population normal norms (lower is better). Double-click speed logs inter-click intervals, keeps the fastest valid interval over 10 rounds, and shows jitter in a histogram. Beat synchronization pre-schedules 20 exact beats with AudioContext.currentTime (no setInterval-driven audio); your click offset vs the nearest beat is early (−)/late (+), and consistency is the SD of offsets — smaller is steadier. Norms are empirical, for self-reference only.

time-perception.📌 时间感知受注意力、年龄、疲劳与情境影响。专业音乐训练者通常节奏一致性更好；咖: 📌 Time perception depends on attention, age, fatigue and context. Trained musicians usually show steadier rhythm; caffeine or fatigue shifts your estimation bias. nback-training.N-Back 是工作记忆研究的经典范式：每个刺激出现时，判断它与「前 N 个」刺: N-Back is a classic working-memory paradigm: on each stimulus, judge whether it matches the one N steps back on the relevant channel. Supports single-channel (position) and dual-channel (position + letters/digits/colors), with fixed or adaptive N. It reports position hit rate, audio hit rate and the signal-detection metric d′ in real time, and plots daily training curves.
nback-training.命中率 HR = 命中数 / 信号试次数，虚报率 FA = 虚报数 / 噪声试次: Hit rate HR = hits / signal trials; false-alarm rate FA = false alarms / noise trials. A log-linear correction (HR′=(H+0.5)/(S+1), FA′=(F+0.5)/(N+1)) avoids 0/1 extremes; z-scores use the Acklam inverse normal CDF approximation, and d′ = z(HR′) − z(FA′). In dual-channel mode, position and letter d′ are computed independently. Adaptive rule: 4 fully correct trials in a row → N+1 (cap 9); 3 erroneous trials in a row → N−1 (floor 1).
nback-training.键位：单通道按 =匹配 / =不匹配；双通道 位置按 =匹配 =不匹配，字母按: Keys: single-channel press = match / = non-match; dual-channel position = match / non-match, letter = match / non-match. On-screen buttons also work. With voice on, letters are spoken aloud (letter set only).
nback-training.使用边界：本工具用于认知训练与自我监测，所有指标来自信号检测论的数学推算，。若有: Scope of use: this tool is for cognitive training and self-monitoring; all metrics are mathematical derivations from signal detection theory. For concerns about attention or memory, consult a professional. Voice relies on the browser's SpeechSynthesis; some environments don't support it or require user interaction first.

stroop-test.斯特鲁普效应揭示「读词」与「报色」两个自动化加工之间的冲突：当字义颜色与墨水颜色: The Stroop effect reveals the conflict between two automatic processes — reading words and naming colors: when word meaning and ink color disagree, naming the ink color gets slower and more error-prone. This three-stage test quantifies your personal interference and compares it with norms.
stroop-test.Stroop 干扰量（Interference）= 不一致条件（字义≠墨色）平均: Stroop interference = mean RT in the incongruent condition (word ≠ ink) − mean RT in the congruent condition (word = ink), in milliseconds; interference rate = interference ÷ congruent mean RT × 100%. Error bars show SEM = SD ÷ √n. Norms: healthy adults show ~30–100 ms interference, ~8–20% rate; error rate typically rises slightly in the incongruent condition. RTs are averaged over correct, answered trials only; timeouts count as errors.
stroop-test.键位： 红 / 绿 / 蓝 / 黄。也可点击屏幕上的颜色按钮。请始终报出，而不是: Keys: red / green / blue / yellow. On-screen color buttons also work. Always respond to the ink color, not the word meaning.
stroop-test.使用边界：本测试用于认知心理学的趣味自我评估与教学演示，。干扰量会受疲劳、语言熟: Scope of use: this test is for fun self-assessment and teaching demos of cognitive psychology. Interference varies with fatigue, language proficiency and attention; for research, fix device and environment and average repeated runs. The neutral condition uses non-color words to remove direct word–color conflict.

schulte-table.舒尔特方格（Schulte Table）是经典的注意力与视觉搜索能力训练工具。按: The Schulte Table is a classic trainer for attention and visual search. Tap the cells in the required order as fast as you can; the app tracks time, tap rate and errors in real time, saves each run and plots your history. Everything runs locally in your browser — no network needed.
schulte-table.方格内数字 1…N 随机分布，要求在最短时间内按正序（1→N）或倒序（N→1）依: Numbers 1…N are randomly scattered across the grid; clear them in ascending (1→N) or descending (N→1) order as fast as possible. Core metrics: completion time T (s), error count E, and tap rate R = N / T (cells/s, higher is better). Attention is often gauged by mean time per cell — lower means more efficient visual search. In color-name mode, cells show color words ordered by hidden indices, adding interference-resistance and Stroop-like inhibition demands.
schulte-table.提示：每点错一次会震动并计入错误次数，但进度不会前进——必须点中下一个正确方格才: Tip: each wrong tap vibrates and counts as an error but doesn't advance progress — you must hit the next correct cell to continue. In color-name mode, ignore the text color and tap by hidden index.
schulte-table.暂无该规格的练习记录，先完成一组训练吧。: No records for this size yet — finish a run first.

corsi-block-test.Corsi 木块敲击测试（Corsi Block-Tapping Test）用于: The Corsi Block-Tapping Test measures visual–spatial short-term memory span. Blocks light up one by one; tap them back in the same (forward) or reverse (backward) order. A staircase auto-adjusts difficulty. Everything runs locally.
corsi-block-test.每块序列长度 L 随机生成、互不重复。每个长度做 2 次试次：只要 2 次中答对: Each sequence length L is randomly generated without repeats. Two trials per length: passing at least 1 of 2 advances to L+1; 2 consecutive failures end the test. Corsi span = the last length passed, +0.5 if only 1/2 correct at that length. Product Score = the sum of all correctly reproduced lengths, more sensitive to capacity and interference. Approximate norms: children ≈ 4.8, adults ≈ 5.5, older adults ≈ 4.9.
corsi-block-test.点击「开始测试」后，观察木块依次亮起，再按规则点回去。: Click "Start test", watch the blocks light up in sequence, then tap them back per the rules.
corsi-block-test.提示：演示阶段木块高亮由系统控制；进入输入阶段后，正序请按亮起顺序点击，倒序请按: Tip: during presentation the highlights are system-controlled; in input phase, tap in the lit order for forward, reversed for backward. Faster pace and longer sequences approach real memory load.

digit-span-test.数字广度（Digit Span）是 WAIS 智力测验中测量言语工作记忆广度的经: Digit Span is a classic WAIS subtest for verbal working-memory span. Digits appear one at a time at a steady pace; recall them per the rules. Three conditions — forward, backward, and sequencing — with staircase difficulty and optional spoken presentation.
digit-span-test.每个长度呈现 2 次试次：2 次中至少答对 1 次即晋升到更长序列；同一长度连续: Two trials per length: at least 1 of 2 correct advances to a longer sequence; 2 consecutive full failures at the same length end the test. Span = last length passed, +0.5 if only 1/2 correct there. Total span = mean of forward, backward and sequencing spans; Sequencing score = sequencing span. Approximate WAIS adult norms: forward ≈ 6.5, backward ≈ 5.5, sequencing ≈ 5.0 (rough reference only, not clinical diagnosis).
digit-span-test.设置速度与条件后点击「开始本条件」。运行全部三项会自动依次进行正背、倒背、排序。: Set speed and condition, then click "Start this condition". "Run all three" automatically runs forward, backward and sequencing in order.
digit-span-test.提示：序列只呈现一次，请集中注意力。倒背要求把听到的数字反着说；排序要求把数字从: Tip: each sequence is shown only once — stay focused. Backward means speak the digits in reverse; sequencing means speak them from smallest to largest. Faster pace approaches real working-memory load. All data stays in your local browser.
